_comment: How far a chart zooms (components/ui/inputs/ZoomBar, lib/hooks/useZoom): 1 is the chart fitted to its frame. min and max are the least and most it is drawn at; step is what a − or + press, the arrow keys and a slider notch move it by. The Map's charts never shrink far (their words would not read); the Terms tree can, to take in the whole of it.
